name: TAX_BLOCK_POLYGON
description: This dataset contains polygon records for tax blocks, the geographic units used for property tax administration. Each of the 5,000 sampled rows represents one block and includes a unique object identifier, borough, block number, section and volume numbers, and several status flags (an end-of-page overlap flag and a jagged-status flag). It also records audit fields such as the user and date of creation and last edit, plus geometric measures for area and perimeter length. The data could be used to map tax blocks, join property records to block-level geography, analyze block sizes and shapes across boroughs, or track edits and data quality over time.
